judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 35 to the President to cancel the federal environmental agency rule implementing the waste emissions charge on methane released by oil and gas facilities. The Senate passed it 52-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 35 to the President to cancel the federal environmental agency rule implementing the waste emissions charge on methane released by oil and gas facilities. The Senate passed it 52-47.
